main_text.p: archontis officio recitatur sub fine orationis in Macartatum. his verbis: Ὁ ἄρχων ἐπιμελέσθω τῶν ὀρφανῶν, καὶ τ[?] ἐπικλήρων, καὶ τ[?] οἴκων τ[?] ἐξερη-μωμένων, καὶ τ[?] γυναικῶν, ὅσαι [?]φύσιζιν ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις τῶν ἀνδρῶν τ[?] τεθνηκότων φάσκουσαι κυεῖν, τούτων ἐπιμελέσθω. καὶ μὴ ἐάν τῳ ὑοφίζειν, ἢ ποιεῖν τι παρανομῶν. νόμος· ἐᾶν ἐπιβάλλειν καὶ τὸ τέλος. Ἐὰν ὁ μείζονος ζημίας δοκῇ ἄξιος εἶναι, [illegible, ~6 letters] καὶ τίμημα ἐπιγραφὰ[?] ὁ, ὃ ἂν δοκῇ αὐτῷ εἰσαγαγεῖν εἰς τὴν Ἡλιαίαν. Ἐὰν δ' ἀλλὰ, [?]ἡ Ἡλιαία ἀπὸ ἀλόγου ὁ, ἂν ... ἀποτίσειν ἢ ἀπιστίαν. Praeter g adoptandi jus licebat lege Solonis, quot-quot genuini cives erant, non adscitii, cum Solon magistratum iniret, testamentum condere, & de rebus suis pro arbitrio disponere, haeredes instituere, quos volebant, legare, tutores haeredibus dare, modo id facerent secundum leges. Quod sic statuit Solon, ait Demosthenes contra Leptinem, non ut genere proximos jure propinquitatis fraudaret, sed ut utilitate in medium propositâ efficeret, ut homines inter se bene-

page.notes: Left margin carries several damaged reference marks and short notes (H X, Solo, es., rei, bioz, rec, and similar fragments), which are too faint to read reliably; the note marked "g" is a best reading. The Greek line-ends with bracketed uncertainties in the Greek are doubtful; the Greek accents and breathings are approximate. The long-s ligature in "adfcitii", "fuis", "fecundum", "ftatuit", "fe" has been rendered with plain s. The text ends with the catchword "bene-" at the foot.
